description: Original articulation_points tests.rs with independent finite checks and typed models.
state: Fixed deterministic Rust fixtures and production functions on the finite graph corpus; one complete test invocation with pass/fail assertions.
cost: Finite corpus cost: connectivity closure is O(V^3) per deletion and exhaustive trail search is O(E! * E) in the worst case; bounded at V<=5, E<=10. Deep-chain production fixture is O(30000) time/space; no general oracle efficiency claim.
forward: Generate all bounded ordered multigraphs and simple graphs; independently compute deletion connectivity or exhaustively enumerate edge trails. Assert exact production agreement, validate witnesses, exercise boundaries and transformations, and run a deep chain. Return harness pass only if every assertion holds.
inverse: Let U be fixed harness configurations crossed with pass/fail outcomes and R the forward assertion semantics. U minus R excludes a passing run with a violated checked equality or malformed witness. This is an exact specification complement and only a partial hypothesis about compiler/runner correspondence; finite passing evidence is not its definition.

The preimage of pass comprises every implementation and runner state agreeing with all executed observations, including incorrect implementations outside sampled cases. The preimage of assertion failure comprises every state falsifying at least one reached assertion; it does not uniquely locate a defect.
limitations: Finite checks are not unrestricted proof.
Partial syntax has no macro expansion or semantic resolution.
Executable approximate categorical semantics are not defined.
